acceptance_rule.campaign_acceptance: Exactly five fresh worker/process constructions must each materialize the sealed live PCM fixture, complete S then A in one engine, cover every listed applicable case/boundary, pass all non-waived exact metadata/discrete/KV checks, emit every predeclared finite directional statistic, and retain conv layer 0 as an exact zero-drift leaf. Any error rejects calibration and authorizes no envelope.
acceptance_rule.derivation: For each lane/case/boundary/full-leaf key, use the five-observation extrema with multiplier 1.0: signed minimum and maximum delta; minimum and maximum positive, negative, zero, and differing-element counts; and maximum L1, L2, and Linf norm. A leaf exact in all five observations receives a zero-required envelope. The observed A rules are separately keyed for A and copied as the pre-causal ordinary-packed baseline for B; this is not an artifact-matched causal-case oracle.
acceptance_rule.held_out_use: The twelve Phase 1 replicates are held out. They may only be tested once against this sealed envelope. Phase 1 observations may never widen, replace, or recalibrate any rule.
acceptance_rule.replicate_failure: A missing statistic, orientation mismatch, new or missing leaf, dtype/shape/element-count mismatch, non-finite value, sign-count or differing-support range violation, signed-bound violation, norm inclusive-ceiling exceedance, or zero-envelope violation fails the Phase 1 replicate. Equality at an inclusive ceiling passes.
acceptance_rule.terminal_causal_limit: The terminal causal case is excluded because released A may not return state. No numeric envelope or semantic-equivalence conclusion is authorized there; only B1 liveness localization may use the future Phase 1 result.
